place.name: Isla Entre Ríos
place.description: Entre Ríos Island (Spanish: Isla Entre Ríos 'Between Rivers Island') is an uninhabited island in the Paraná Delta that constitutes an exclave of Argentina in waters belonging to Paraguay. It is part of the municipality of Berón de Astrada, which covers the entire Berón de Astrada Department in the north of Corrientes Province, Mesopotamia.
